native_inspection.WebGLTextures.js:904: DataArrayTexture selects TEXTURE_2D_ARRAY, not one 2D atlas.
native_inspection.WebGLTextures.js:234: Unsigned-byte sRGB transfer selects SRGB8_ALPHA8. GPU sampling decodes base color to linear; no extra manual gamma code is added.
native_inspection.WebGLTextures.js:1168-1207: Texture allocation/upload has discrete depth layers via texStorage3D/texSubImage3D or texImage3D with width,height,depth.
native_inspection.WebGLTextures.js:1391-1393: generateMipmaps=true uses generateMipmap on that TEXTURE_2D_ARRAY target. Array filtering/mip generation preserve each layer rather than mixing adjacent atlas slots.
native_inspection.DataArrayTexture.js:79-93: flipY defaults false; uploaded RGBA rows are mapped by per-face custom surfaceUv. wrapR defaults ClampToEdgeWrapping.
native_inspection.SurfaceTextures.ts: 10 layers cover AIR0/placeables1..8/boundary9. Supplied images are assigned only1..8; fallback/boundary remain procedural. min LinearMipmapLinear,mag Linear,RepeatS/T; bounded anisotropy light2/std4 capped hardware.

render_inspection: Basic and Standard share one surfaces.uniform; no per-voxel/material/renderer allocation. Chunk positions/normals carry constant BlockID per face.

Standard vertexColors false avoids old palette multiplying source colors and gray face-shadow plus real light double shading; Basic uses neutral grayscale face shades, not legacy material colors. Both base color white.
Successful tier swap disposes prior array once. All8decode validity checked before replacing. Aborted older epochs/destroyed results cannot alter latest uniform.
Canonical ASCII BASE_URL paths support normal root/subpath; no user Windows paths at runtime.
Current tests are JS/native-Three configuration and concurrency assertions, not direct driver pixel/mipmap proof. Actual GPU screenshot and shader console checks are separate browser QA.
limits: No claim that static screenshots prove all movement shimmer or all physical devices.
No physical iPhone/Android or human enjoyment test here.
